headline: MEEK EYES 'CITY OF GOD' PRODUCER
body: Meek Mill publicly asked to connect with City of God producer Andrea Barata Ribeiro for his planned 'YN' movie. He says he wants a real film—not simply a rap project. No collaboration has been announced.
caption:
Meek Mill publicly asked to connect with City of God producer Andrea Barata Ribeiro for his planned 'YN' movie. He says he wants a real film—not simply a rap project. No collaboration has been announced.

Meek Mill (@meekmill) first said he wanted a City of God producer to help shoot the movie, then specifically asked for a connection to Ribeiro. The Oscar-nominated Brazilian film remains his stated creative reference point; Ribeiro has not publicly joined the project.

Sources: Complex, Aug. 28, and 24HipHop, Aug. 29, 2026. Original RapWire 24/7 comic illustration redrawn from Complex's lead portrait of Meek Mill, photographed by Prince Williams/WireImage.
